title: Mohan Babu University Hosts 4th International Conference on Sustainable Practices in Business Management
summary: Mohan Babu University's School of Commerce and Management hosted INCSPBM–2026 in Tirupati, a three-day international conference on AI, sustainability and digital transformation in business.
body_html:
Tirupati, 17 November 2026: The School of Commerce and Management at Mohan Babu University (MBU), Tirupati, has organised the 4th International Conference on Sustainable Practices in Business Management (INCSPBM–2026) on the theme “Redefining Business Ecosystems through AI, Sustainability, and Digital Transformation.” The three-day conference brought together academicians, researchers, students, research scholars and industry professionals to discuss emerging trends in sustainable and technology-driven business management.

The conference was inaugurated on 12 November 2026 in the presence of Prof. Dhruba Kumar Gautam of Tribhuvan University, Nepal; Prof. Nithyananda K. V. of IIM Trichy; and Mr. Lokesh Naidu, Founder & CEO, Octopi Health, Bengaluru. The guests spoke about the importance of integrating Artificial Intelligence, sustainability, digital transformation and responsible business practices to build future-ready business ecosystems.

Sessions covered a range of themes, including AI and Digital Transformation, Sustainable Business and ESG, AI-Driven Marketing, Finance and FinTech, HRM and Responsible Leadership, Entrepreneurship and Supply Chain Management, and Responsible AI and Governance. Participants came from the USA, UK, Nepal, Uzbekistan, Sri Lanka and Thailand, as well as from institutions across India. The programme included keynote addresses, expert sessions, panel discussions and research presentations.

A highlight of the conference was an expert virtual session on “Harmonisation of Sustainability Reporting Frameworks” by Prof. Jill Atkins, Professor, Cardiff University, UK. She offered international perspectives on sustainability reporting and ESG disclosures, and on the need for closer alignment among global sustainability reporting frameworks.

A panel discussion on “Sustainable Business in the Age of AI: Innovation, ESG and Responsible Leadership” examined how organisations can balance technological innovation and profitability with environmental sustainability, social responsibility and ethical leadership. Research scholars and participants presented papers across the conference tracks, and outstanding contributions were recognised with Best Paper Awards.

The conference closed with a valedictory session at which Prof. Dr. S. Ganapathy Venkatasubramanian, Professor, Anna University, Chennai, was the Chief Guest. He stressed the importance of bringing sustainability, technological innovation, environmental responsibility and ethical practices into contemporary business management.

According to the university, INCSPBM–2026 served as an international and multidisciplinary platform for sharing research, exchanging knowledge and building collaborations, in line with Mohan Babu University’s focus on sustainability, quality research and global academic engagement.
